stimulus.detail: Interrupt a collection, then reconcile.

cases.statement: An interrupted collection reconciles by repeating the exact operation against sealed bytes.

stimulus.detail: Materialize a directory source and enumerate the tree.

cases.statement: The materialized tree digest, entry count and total bytes equal the declared content manifest.

stimulus.detail: Stop the writer, observe quiescence, then freeze.

cases.statement: Freeze commits only after a quiescent runtime observation.

stimulus.detail: Freeze different bytes under the same operation id.

cases.statement: A freeze of different bytes under the same operation id refuses.

stimulus.detail: Freeze, then recompute the manifest digest over collected bytes.

cases.statement: The frozen-result manifest digest recomputes over the collected bytes.

stimulus.detail: Retry the exact freeze operation.

cases.statement: An exact freeze retry replays byte-for-byte and commits nothing a second time.

stimulus.detail: Materialize a git source whose manifest binds an exact base revision.

cases.statement: The workspace resolves to the exact base_revision the input manifest bound.

stimulus.detail: Move the source ref after binding, then materialize.

cases.statement: A source ref that moved after binding refuses rather than taking the new tip.

stimulus.detail: Probe attempts a write into a declared input path.

cases.statement: A write into a declared input path does not succeed; inputs are read-only to the worker.

stimulus.detail: Suppress a required output, then declare.

cases.statement: A missing required output yields 'unable' with the absence recorded, never 'completed'.

stimulus.detail: Declare two outputs whose destinations overlap.

cases.statement: Two declared outputs whose destinations overlap are refused.

stimulus.detail: Place a symlink inside a declared output and freeze.

cases.statement: A symlink or reparse point inside a declared output is refused at freeze.

stimulus.detail: Declare an output path containing a traversal segment.

cases.statement: A declared output path containing a traversal segment is refused.

stimulus.detail: Publish a proposal and read the canonical target.

cases.statement: The proposal is an immutable artifact and the canonical target revision is unchanged.

stimulus.detail: Probe writes outside every declared output, then collect.

cases.statement: A file written outside every declared output is not collected.

stimulus.detail: Run two concurrent assignments; each probes for the other's paths.

cases.statement: Neither runtime can read or write the other's workspace or declared output.

stimulus.detail: Probe reads which object store the workspace resolves against.

cases.statement: The workspace's Git metadata resolves only against its private object store.

stimulus.detail: Probe attempts egress inside and outside the pinned policy.

cases.statement: Egress beyond the pinned network policy does not succeed.

stimulus.detail: Probe attempts to resolve and open the authority home and database.

cases.statement: No path resolving into the authority home or its database is reachable from the runtime.

stimulus.detail: Probe attempts to resolve the Baton executable and configuration.

cases.statement: The Baton executable and configuration are not reachable from the runtime.

stimulus.detail: Probe attempts to resolve the canonical repository.

cases.statement: The canonical repository is not mounted; only the private copy is.

stimulus.detail: Probe attempts to exceed the pinned resource limits.

cases.statement: Resource use beyond the pinned limits does not succeed.

stimulus.detail: Probe enumerates the tools available to it.

cases.statement: No tool outside the pinned tool policy is available to the worker.

stimulus.detail: Emit a burst of activity and read the projection either side.

cases.statement: A burst of activity leaves phase, Handler, contract and generation unchanged.

stimulus.detail: Read the assignment manifest and the authority claim event.

cases.statement: The assignment manifest exists only after the claim committed and binds the live generation.

stimulus.detail: Interrupt the claim mid-flight and inspect.

cases.statement: While a claim is unsettled, no writable runtime starts.

stimulus.detail: Restart the manager, then settle the claim.

cases.statement: The claim is settled by exact operation replay, not by reading the current Handler.

stimulus.detail: Decline while carrying the claim bearer.

cases.statement: A decline that transmits the bearer is refused; the offer is not terminated.

stimulus.detail: Decline an issued offer with claim_token null.

cases.statement: A decline carrying no bearer terminates its own offer, spends the verifier and commits no claim.

stimulus.detail: Decline naming one offer while carrying another offer's attempt or Work.

cases.statement: A differently bound decline refuses and terminates neither the named offer nor the bound one.

stimulus.detail: Probe before and after activation.

cases.statement: No writable path or execution tool exists before assignment.activate.

stimulus.detail: Inspect the offer frame before any decision.

cases.statement: The offer frame carries metadata and digests only; no input bytes.

stimulus.detail: Probe the consent runtime for writable paths and input.

cases.statement: The consent runtime reaches no input, no output and no writable path.

stimulus.detail: Emit activity under a superseded generation.

cases.statement: Activity under a superseded generation refuses.

stimulus.detail: Publish a proposal under a superseded generation.

cases.statement: A proposal published under a superseded generation refuses.

stimulus.detail: Declare a result under a superseded generation.

cases.statement: A result declared under a superseded generation refuses.

stimulus.detail: Advance the clock past expiry, then decide.

cases.statement: An expired claim token refuses; the Work stays queued, unclaimed and offerable.

stimulus.detail: Replay a token that was already spent.

cases.statement: A replayed claim token refuses; no second claim commits.

stimulus.detail: Present a token against a different offer, Work or participant.

cases.statement: A token presented against a different offer, Work or participant refuses.

stimulus.detail: Reach agent quiescence, then read the gate and its clearance evidence.

cases.statement: No gate clearance cites an agent-session observation.

stimulus.detail: Cancel, then read the gate before inspecting.

cases.statement: A successful cancel reply does not by itself satisfy the quiescence gate.

stimulus.detail: Cancel with partial output present, then collect.

cases.statement: Partial output at cancellation is sealed with its Work, generation, reason and policy provenance.

stimulus.detail: Destroy the runtime, satisfy the gate, claim a successor.

cases.statement: A positive destroyed observation clears the gate and the successor mints the next generation.

stimulus.detail: Attempt discard with no pinned disposable-attempt policy.

cases.statement: Discarding recoverable output without a pinned disposable-attempt policy refuses.

stimulus.detail: Cancel, then read the ordered event journal.

cases.statement: The fence-and-end authority transaction precedes every stop order.

stimulus.detail: Publish after the fence.

cases.statement: Publication attempted after the fence refuses.

stimulus.detail: Observe quiescence and read the gate.

cases.statement: A quiescent observation does not clear runtime-quiescence.

stimulus.detail: Attempt a replacement claim while gated.

cases.statement: A replacement claim refuses while the quiescence gate is visibly held.

stimulus.detail: Attempt retention beyond the pinned policy.

cases.statement: Retention beyond the pinned policy refuses; retention is not acceptance.

stimulus.detail: After cancellation, claim an unrelated Work as the same participant.

cases.statement: The participant may claim an unrelated Work while the cancelled Work stays gated.

stimulus.detail: Partition the runtime, then inspect.

cases.statement: An unreachable runtime records 'uncertain', never 'destroyed'.

stimulus.detail: Restart the adapter mid-attempt, then reconcile its runtime observations.

cases.statement: After an adapter restart the same runtime is re-identified and no second runtime starts.

stimulus.detail: Drop the agent transport mid-turn.

cases.statement: A dropped agent transport ends the epoch 'unknown' with no resume and no re-prompt.

stimulus.detail: Run cleanup while a sealed record is pending intake.

cases.statement: Cleanup reports blocked-on-intake and changes no authority state.

stimulus.detail: Duplicate and delay a frame carrying the same message id.

cases.statement: A duplicated or delayed frame produces no second durable effect.

stimulus.detail: Deliver a duplicate runtime observation.

cases.statement: A duplicate runtime observation replays without a second effect.

stimulus.detail: Produce two runtimes for one attempt.

cases.statement: A duplicated runtime start cancels the assignment rather than adopting one.

stimulus.detail: Retry the exact operation.

cases.statement: An exact operation retry replays byte-for-byte.

stimulus.detail: Restart the manager mid-operation, then reconcile.

cases.statement: After restart the ambiguous operation is reconciled against both durable records.

stimulus.detail: Report an observation earlier than the recorded one.

cases.statement: A regressive runtime observation refuses; the axis never walks backwards.

stimulus.detail: Reuse an operation id with a different signature.

cases.statement: The same operation id with a different signature refuses and changes nothing.

stimulus.detail: Reuse one operation id for output.freeze and output.collect, whose bodies are byte-identical.

cases.statement: Two kinds carrying identical operands are different operations, so the second under one id collides rather than replaying.

stimulus.detail: Change a durable operand, recompute ONLY the body digest, and retain the previous operation signature.

cases.statement: A command whose operation signature does not recompute over its own kind and operands refuses and writes nothing.

stimulus.detail: Partition, heal, then reattach.

cases.statement: Reattachment cites an exact runtime identity and the full assignment.

stimulus.detail: Heal the partition onto a different runtime and attempt reattachment.

cases.statement: Transport reachability alone is refused as evidence of runtime identity.

stimulus.detail: Restart the remote runtime host, then inspect and attempt a replacement.

cases.statement: A restarted remote host leaves the runtime uncertain and the replacement gated.

stimulus.detail: Plant one canary per named surface and scan all ten.

cases.statement: Every surface worker-control 9 names is scanned, evidenced by a planted canary found in each.

stimulus.detail: Expire the credential mid-run and probe its use.

cases.statement: A credential that expires during a run stops working and the expiry is reported.

stimulus.detail: Activate with a credential below the pinned remaining-lifetime floor.

cases.statement: A credential below the pinned remaining-lifetime floor refuses before execution.

stimulus.detail: Present one assignment's credential from another assignment's runtime.

cases.statement: One assignment's credential grants nothing in another assignment's runtime.

stimulus.detail: Deliver the credential and probe its scope and persistence.

cases.statement: The credential is delivered out of band, scoped to the exact assignment, and not persisted.

stimulus.detail: Plant a canary in the output, then publish.

cases.statement: A detected leak refuses publication.

stimulus.detail: Plant a credential canary and scan events, errors and logs.

cases.statement: No credential appears in any event, error or retained log.

stimulus.detail: Plant a credential canary and scan every durable manifest.

cases.statement: No credential appears in any durable manifest or artifact locator.

stimulus.detail: Read the assessor's residual-risk statement.

cases.statement: The run reports which surfaces were scanned and what remains unproven.

stimulus.detail: Script one approval request per family and capture each reply.

cases.statement: Each denial payload validates against its family's provider response schema.

stimulus.detail: Script an approval arriving after cancellation was ordered.

cases.statement: An approval arriving after cancellation takes the identical non-granting answer.

stimulus.detail: Script an unexpected approval request.

cases.statement: An unexpected approval request grants nothing.

stimulus.detail: Make the artifact store unreachable.

cases.statement: An unreachable artifact store is reported unavailable, never as a refusal.

stimulus.detail: Make the authority unreachable.

cases.statement: An unreachable authority is reported unavailable with operation_state unknown.

stimulus.detail: Send a message requiring an unselected capability.

cases.statement: A message requiring an unselected capability refuses before any side effect.

stimulus.detail: Collect the error frame from every control-refusal case in the run.

cases.statement: Every refused control operation yields a control.error with its pair, retry class and operation_state.

stimulus.detail: Send an unnegotiated extension.

cases.statement: An unnegotiated extension refuses before any side effect.

stimulus.detail: Withhold the pinned mode from the scripted agent.

cases.statement: An unavailable pinned mode fails visibly rather than falling back.

stimulus.detail: Reject a plan, then reoffer the identical one.

cases.statement: The plan-revision gate blocks reoffering the identical plan.

stimulus.detail: Report provider operands differing from the pinned ones.

cases.statement: Provider operands differing from the pinned ones fail the turn.

stimulus.detail: Produce a run with a failed core case and read the emitted profile signal.

cases.statement: A run with a failed portable core case emits a probation signal bound to the profile and adapter digests.

stimulus.detail: Recompute every digest the proposal binds.

cases.statement: Every digest the proposal binds matches what the run actually used.

stimulus.detail: Script a transcript claiming success, failure and completion.

cases.statement: No portable state is derived from agent prose, tool status or diagnostics.

stimulus.detail: Write each workflow receipt twice with different content.

cases.statement: A second differing write to any workflow receipt refuses.

stimulus.detail: Make the source provider unreachable.

cases.statement: An unreachable source provider is reported unavailable, never as a refusal.

stimulus.detail: Act under a superseded contract selector.

cases.statement: An act under a superseded contract selector refuses.

stimulus.detail: Move the canonical target, then integrate.

cases.statement: A moved canonical target refuses integration and journals exactly one attempt.

stimulus.detail: Withdraw profile certification, then attempt execution.

cases.statement: An uncertified runtime profile cannot execute the contract.

stimulus.detail: Declare schema-valid but hostile worker output.

cases.statement: Schema-valid worker output is still treated as untrusted.

stimulus.detail: Read route policy and profile certification either side of a run.

cases.statement: The suite reports a verdict and mutates no route policy or profile certification.

stimulus.detail: Offer an unsupported protocol version.

cases.statement: An unsupported protocol version refuses before any side effect.

stimulus.detail: Enumerate everything the agent endpoint received.

cases.statement: Nothing the agent endpoint received carries a Baton capability.

stimulus.detail: Report an agent-session state earlier than the recorded one.

cases.statement: A regressive agent-session state refuses.

stimulus.detail: Order cancellation and let the drain deadline elapse.

cases.statement: No terminal fact within the drain deadline records agent-quiescence-unknown.

stimulus.detail: Order cancellation and observe the terminal fact.

cases.statement: Cancellation records the order, then whichever terminal fact actually occurred.

stimulus.detail: Capture the client capabilities the relay advertised.

cases.statement: The relay advertises no filesystem, terminal or other client capability.

stimulus.detail: Run a consent posture, settle the claim, then run an execution posture.

cases.statement: One attempt hosts a consent session with no assignment and a separate execution session with the exact one.

stimulus.detail: Declare a disposition outside the set the observed turn outcome permits.

cases.statement: A disposition outside the set permitted by the turn outcome refuses.

stimulus.detail: Deliver an identical duplicate, then a conflicting one.

cases.statement: Events are sealed and bounded; a conflicting duplicate refuses rather than merging.

stimulus.detail: Script one provider update per normalized kind, plus an unmapped one.

cases.statement: Every scripted provider update maps into the closed event set; unmapped kinds become 'other'.

stimulus.detail: Overflow the relay queue.

cases.statement: Queue overflow drops are counted durably, never silent.

stimulus.detail: Open two epochs and compare provider session identities.

cases.statement: Each epoch opens a new provider session; none is reused.

stimulus.detail: Attempt session load, resume and fork.

cases.statement: Load, resume and fork are never sent and are refused if attempted.

stimulus.detail: Search durable records for identities derived from a provider session id.

cases.statement: No Baton participant, Handler or assignment is derived from a provider session id.

stimulus.detail: Script one ending per closed turn outcome.

cases.statement: Each scripted ending produces its mapped closed turn outcome and names its terminal fact.

stimulus.detail: Script an agent call to an unadvertised client method.

cases.statement: An agent call to an unadvertised client method is refused, and the turn fails.
